text: With TreVeyon Henderson declaring himself "ready to go" after missing Week 1 with an ankle injury, the Patriots are working to bounce back against a rolling Steelers team that will test a defense already dealing with significant absences—most notably A.J. Brown's high ankle sprain that sidelines him for four weeks, a loss that will require creative adjustments in coverage schemes and secondary depth. On the roster front, the team shuffled its offensive line by signing Xavier Newman-Johnson to the practice squad while releasing Jacob Rizy, a move suggesting ongoing evaluation of depth at a crucial position group. In a poignant moment of franchise history, All-Pro cornerback Stephon Gilmore will return to Foxborough on Friday to retire as a Patriot, bringing closure to a legendary tenure under Bill Belichick's system, while separately owner Robert Kraft made headlines announcing he had removed Macklemore as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's Gillette Stadium performances, citing the artist's "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery."
